name: Vast.ai GPU broker
audience_feeling: Able to tell what the evidence supports, what remains unknown, and which inputs authorize a paid action.
promise: Make model-hosting decisions traceable from artifact evidence through live cost and cleanup status.

preferred_terms.not yet proven: unknown or unverified, with the missing evidence named

avoid: guarantees that depend on provider or network availability
confusing stopped instances with destroyed instances
marketing claims unsupported by repository evidence
good_examples: This quote includes the requested disk allocation; the network charge is still unknown.
The source reports this as a tested configuration, not a minimum requirement.
bad_examples: This is the cheapest GPU available.
Cleanup is guaranteed even if the controller loses access.
